question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Scale
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Scale"** means a system or series of marks used for measuring or registering. It can also refer to the size or level of something, especially in comparison to something else. (मापक यंत्र, पैमाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The** scale **of the project was impressive, covering several square miles.
 
 
 
• **"Magnitude"** refers to the great size or extent of something. It can also relate to the importance or significance of something. (परिमाण, महत्ता)
 
 
• **Example: **The** magnitude** of the earthquake was measured at 7.8 on the Richter scale.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Scale' **is **'Magnitude'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lethargy **(सुस्ती): A lack of energy and enthusiasm.

 
 
• **Example:** The hot weather induced a feeling of lethargy among the workers.
 
 
 
• **Slide **(फिसलन): To move smoothly along a surface.
 
 
• **Example: **The children love to slide down the hill on their sleds.
 
 
 
• **Chips** (टुकड़े): Small pieces broken off something.
 
 
• **Example:** There were chips of wood all over the workshop floor.
